conventions.purpose: Fault-injection recipes a harness applies from outside to a correct page, to produce labelled examples for visual-check recall, false-report measurement and training data. Nothing here is added to demos, compat apps or templates (AGENTS.md rule 4); the harness injects with page.addInitScript, page.evaluate or page.route.
conventions.kind: fault: a detector should report it. control: a lookalike that is correct; a detector must stay quiet. Count reports on control targets as false reports.
conventions.phase: before-load: rewrite the HTML response before parse. network: route a request. init: script before page scripts. after-load: after the VISUAL.md section 2.3 settle gates, on a visible tab. on-interaction: applied while the harness opens, closes or navigates, or uses real input or an emulation a visitor would trigger (Tab focus, a tap, a click on a link or an export control, print).
conventions.env: Emulation the fault needs to be visible: viewport [w, h], colorScheme, reducedMotion, hasTouch, classicScrollbars (Chromium: inject ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 16px } or run on Linux or Windows), browser (chromium, firefox, webkit), forcedColors ('active': page.emulateMedia({ forcedColors: 'active' })), media ('print': page.emulateMedia({ media: 'print' })), keyboard (true: the harness moves focus with Tab and checks each focused control). A runner that cannot apply a recipe's env must skip the recipe, not run it without the emulation. Empty means the default 1280x800 desktop profile.
conventions.operation: Plain JS run in the page, using the helpers below. Operations assume a clean page; apply one fault per page load unless an experiment says otherwise.
conventions.label: expect: finding or no-finding. kind: the catalog id. v1_kind: the VISUAL.md v1 kind that should report it, or null when no v1 kind covers it. attribute: target (the marked element is the finding's element), culprit (the marked element is the cause of a page-level symptom, such as the element that widens the page), page (the finding is page-level). visible: when a visitor would see it: always, phone, touch, keyboard, dark, interaction, classic-scrollbars.
conventions.verdicts: Record each finding against the labels as true positive, false positive, or NOI (real but not observable, as in VERVE: the DOM shows a fault that pixels do not). Confirm layout labels with a pixel check where the operation could be invisible, for example overlap inside an overflow hidden ancestor.
conventions.dedupe: Drop near-duplicate captures before training (OwlEyes used ORB similarity over 0.8).
conventions.network: Injectors that set third-party URLs (image-invented-unsplash, image-dead-placeholder-host) need network and depend on the host's state that day; image-route-404 is the offline equivalent. Gap-merge recipes that load third-party content: embed-rickroll-placeholder, control-embed-real-video, embed-youtube-dead-id, control-embed-live-video, embed-maps-placeholder-key, control-maps-query-embed (YouTube and Google Maps) and video-source-dead-sample (Google's sample bucket). The ids and URLs were checked once on 2026-10-13; video-source-404 is the offline equivalent for video.

helpers.pick(selector, root?): one visible candidate (VISUAL.md 2.1 visible()) chosen by the seeded RNG; the injector is skipped and recorded as not applicable when there is none
helpers.pickMany(selector, min, max, root?): between min and max visible candidates; skip when fewer than min
helpers.tallest(selector): the visible candidate with the largest height
helpers.css(text): append <style data-bench-fault=id> with text to head
helpers.deleteRules(predicate): delete every readable CSSOM rule (recursing into grouping rules) for which predicate(rule) is true
helpers.setText(el, text): replace the first non-empty text node of el
helpers.textNodes(el): the non-empty text nodes under el
helpers.resolvedBackground(el): the VISUAL.md 2.4 effective background colour of el; skip the injector when it abstains
helpers.route(urlOrRegExp, response): harness network interception (Playwright page.route): urlOrRegExp may also be a predicate (url: URL) => boolean; { status } fails the request, { delayMs } delays it, { status, body, contentType } replaces it, an image response replaces it with that image; times: n in the response applies it to the first n matching requests only
helpers.resizedImage(url, width): an image response holding the original scaled to width
helpers.firstJsonListRequest: the first same-origin GET with a JSON array response seen on a clean load
helpers.rewriteHtml(fn): route the document request and replace its body with fn(html) before parse
helpers.stripImgDimensions(html, n): remove width, height and aspect classes from the first n img tags
helpers.swapFirstTwoStylesheetLinks(html): swap the first two link rel=stylesheet tags in head
helpers.removeInlineThemeScript(): with rewriteHtml, drop inline head scripts that set a theme class or data-theme
helpers.rewriteDarkRulesToMedia(): move every CSSOM rule whose selector contains .dark into an @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block with the .dark part removed
helpers.enableAppDarkMode(): set OS dark emulation and the app's own dark state (html.dark, data-theme=dark, or a stored preference) before measuring
helpers.onReady(fn): run fn at DOMContentLoaded (for init-phase injectors)
helpers.onNavigate(fn): run fn after the next pushState or popstate
helpers.openFirstDialog(), closeFirstDialog(), o: harness interactions with real input events (CDP), waiting for transitions to end
helpers.photoUrl, lightPhotoUrl, seed: a bundled same-origin photo, a bundled light photo, the run's RNG seed
helpers.click(el): harness click with real input events (CDP) on el, then wait for the VISUAL.md 2.3 settle gates; after a route change, main-content mutations quiet for 300 ms plus two frames
helpers.tap(el): harness touch tap on el with real touch events in a hasTouch context, finger lifted, then 500 ms
helpers.byText(selector, regExp): the first visible match whose text or aria-label matches regExp; the injector is skipped when there is none
helpers.inAppLink({ lazy }?): a visible same-origin link whose pathname differs from the current one and that has no hash, chosen by the seeded RNG; lazy true or false keeps only links whose navigation did or did not request a new same-origin script on a clean run; skipped when there is none
helpers.inAppRoutes(): same-origin pathnames other than the current one linked from the page on a clean load, in seeded order; skipped when there are none
helpers.gotoDirect(path): harness fresh document navigation to path (page.goto), not pushState; the rest of the operation runs in the new document
helpers.cleanLoadUrls: the set of request URLs seen during the clean load
helpers.openFirstDatePicker(): harness interaction: open the first control that shows a [role=grid] calendar, waiting for transitions to end

injectors.description: Source replaced by a quarter-resolution copy at the same rendered size.
injectors.targets: one visible image at least 300px wide
injectors.operation: const img = pick(sel); const w = img.getBoundingClientRect().width; route(img.currentSrc, resizedImage(img.currentSrc, Math.round(w / 4))); img.removeAttribute('srcset'); img.style.width = w + 'px'; mark(img);

injectors.operation: const v = pick(sel); const s = v.currentSrc || v.src; const u = s + (s.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'bench=404'; route(u, { status: 404 }); for (const el of v.querySelectorAll('source')) el.remove(); v.src = u; v.load(); mark(v);

injectors.operation: const v = pick(sel); v.muted = true; v.setAttribute('muted', ''); v.setAttribute('playsinline', ''); v.play().catch(() => {}); mark(v);

injectors.description: A paused video with controls and no autoplay, meant to be started by the visitor; must not be reported.
injectors.targets: one visible video with a working source
injectors.operation: const v = pick(sel); v.pause(); v.removeAttribute('autoplay'); v.autoplay = false; v.controls = true; v.currentTime = 0; mark(v);

injectors.description: getContext returns null for WebGL before page scripts run, so the scene never initialises.
injectors.targets: a page whose hero or main visual is a WebGL canvas (skip pages without one)
injectors.operation: const get = HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext; HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext = function (type, ...a) { return /^(webgl2?|experimental-webgl)$/.test(type) ? null : get.call(this, type, ...a); }; onReady(() => markPage());

injectors.description: The largest visible WebGL canvas loses its context (WEBGL_lose_context) with no fallback.
injectors.targets: a WebGL canvas covering 20% or more of the viewport
injectors.operation: const big = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('canvas')).filter((c) => { const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width * r.height >= 0.2 * innerWidth * innerHeight; }).sort((a, b) => b.clientWidth * b.clientHeight - a.clientWidth * a.clientHeight); for (const c of big) { const gl = c.getContext('webgl2') || c.getContext('webgl'); const ext = gl && gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context'); if (ext) { ext.loseContext(); mark(c); break; } }

injectors.description: The same lost context with a visible image fallback over the canvas; must not be reported.
injectors.targets: a WebGL canvas covering 20% or more of the viewport
injectors.operation: const big = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('canvas')).filter((c) => { const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width * r.height >= 0.2 * innerWidth * innerHeight; }).sort((a, b) => b.clientWidth * b.clientHeight - a.clientWidth * a.clientHeight); for (const c of big) { const gl = c.getContext('webgl2') || c.getContext('webgl'); const ext = gl && gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context'); if (ext) { ext.loseContext(); const p = c.parentElement; if (getComputedStyle(p).position === 'static') p.style.position = 'relative'; const img = document.createElement('img'); img.src = photoUrl; img.alt = ''; img.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover'; p.append(img); mark(c); break; } }

injectors.description: A CSP meta with img-src 'self' and font-src 'self' at the top of head: remote images and web fonts are blocked (VISUAL.md `csp-blocked`).
injectors.targets: a page with remote images or web fonts (skip if none)
injectors.operation: rewriteHtml((html) => html.replace(/<head(\s[^>]*)?>/i, `<head$1><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'">`)); markPage();

injectors.description: A CSP that allows every image and font host; nothing is blocked and nothing must be reported.
injectors.targets: a page with remote images or web fonts
injectors.operation: rewriteHtml((html) => html.replace(/<head(\s[^>]*)?>/i, `<head$1><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="img-src * data: blob:; font-src * data:">`)); markPage();

injectors.description: A colour class renamed to a shade no build contains.

injectors.description: Emoji prefixed to nav links and feature headings.
injectors.targets: nav links and feature headings
injectors.operation: const icons = ['\u{1F680}', '\u{1F4CA}', '\u{1F512}', '\u2728']; pickMany(sel, 3, 8).forEach((el, i) => { el.prepend(icons[i % 4] + ' '); mark(el); });

injectors.description: A shift that exists only in Gecko; compare engines.
injectors.targets: one block
injectors.operation: const el = pick(sel); el.classList.add('bench-ff'); css('@supports (-moz-appearance: none) { .bench-ff { margin-top: 30px !important; } }'); mark(el);

injectors.description: Odd dialog height puts translate(-50%) on a half pixel.
injectors.targets: a centred dialog
injectors.operation: openFirstDialog(); const d = pick(sel); d.style.height = '401px'; mark(d);

injectors.description: Hover zoom inside a rounded overflow-hidden card.
injectors.targets: a rounded card with an image
injectors.operation: css('.bench-rt img { transition: transform .3s; } .bench-rt:hover img { transform: scale(1.05); }'); const c = pick(sel); c.classList.add('bench-rt'); mark(c);

injectors.description: Images back to inline: baseline gap under each.
injectors.targets: images inside bordered boxes
injectors.operation: css('img { display: inline !important; }'); markAll(sel);

injectors.description: Background image tiles on a wide screen.
injectors.targets: a hero with a background image
injectors.operation: const h = pick(sel); h.style.backgroundRepeat = 'repeat'; h.style.backgroundSize = 'auto'; mark(h);

injectors.description: Grouped vendor selectors: the rule is dropped in every engine.
injectors.targets: inputs with placeholders
injectors.operation: css('input::-webkit-input-placeholder, input::-moz-placeholder { color: #111; }'); markAll(sel);

injectors.description: Light images with no edge on light cards (needs pixels).
injectors.targets: product images with white backgrounds on white cards
injectors.operation: css('[class*=card] img { outline: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: 0 !important; }'); markAll(sel);

injectors.description: Parallax hero on iOS.
injectors.targets: the hero
injectors.operation: const h = pick(sel); h.style.backgroundAttachment = 'fixed'; h.style.backgroundSize = 'cover'; mark(h);

injectors.description: Header, secondary nav and cookie bar take over 60% of a short viewport.
injectors.targets: the header
injectors.operation: const h = pick(sel); h.style.cssText += ';position:sticky;top:0;height:72px;z-index:50'; const n = document.createElement('nav'); n.style.cssText = 'position:sticky;top:72px;height:48px;background:#fff;z-index:49'; h.after(n); const c = document.createElement('div'); c.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:80px;background:#111;color:#fff;z-index:60'; c.textContent = 'Cookies'; document.body.append(c); mark(h);

injectors.description: oklch() colours forced on main, then the export control is clicked: html2canvas 1.x throws on the colour function.
injectors.targets: an export, download or PDF control whose handler uses html2canvas 1.x, html2pdf.js or jsPDF.html() (skip if none)
injectors.operation: css('main, main *{color:oklch(0.35 0.02 260)!important;background-color:oklch(0.98 0 0)!important}'); markPage(); click(byText(sel, /export|download|pdf|save as image/i));

injectors.description: Every @media print rule and print stylesheet removed, then the page printed (print media emulated, as a visitor's Print would).
injectors.targets: a page with @media print rules or a print stylesheet (skip if none)
injectors.operation: deleteRules((r) => r instanceof CSSMediaRule && /print/.test(r.media.mediaText)); for (const l of document.querySelectorAll('link[rel=stylesheet][media*=print]')) l.disabled = true; markPage();

injectors.description: A print stylesheet that hides the header, nav and footer and sets dark text on white; must not be reported.
injectors.targets: a page whose only fixed or sticky bars are the header and nav
injectors.operation: css('@media print{header,nav,footer,[role=banner],[role=navigation],[role=contentinfo]{display:none!important}body,main{color:#000!important;background:#fff!important}}'); markPage();

injectors.description: Card hover rules with an 8px lift and a large shadow, then one card tapped under touch WebKit: the hover state stays after the finger lifts.
injectors.targets: a card that is not a link and holds no link or button
injectors.operation: css('.card:hover, [class*=card]:hover{transform:translateY(-8px)!important;box-shadow:0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / .25)!important}'); const c = pick(sel); tap(c); mark(c);
